question: Who among the following was the recipient of the 29th Vyas Samman?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Nasera Sharma.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Nasera Sharma, is an Indian writer who writes in Hindi.
 
• She has published 10 Hindi languages novels.
 
• Some of her notable works are - Parijat, Mere Priya Kahaniyan, Jajira, Patthar Gali, Aurat ke liye Aurat and Ajnabi.
 
• 
 
The Vyas Samman is a literary award in India started in1991. It is awarded annually by the K.K. Birla Foundation. It includes a cash payout of Rs 4,00,000.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__

 
• **Surendra Verma - **is a Hindi litterateur and a playwright. His famous novels include "Do Murdon K Liye Guldasta", and "Mujhe Chand Chahiye" for which he was bestowed with Sahitya Academy Award.
 
• **Leeladhar Jagudi -** Is an Indian teacher, journalist, and poet of Hindi literature.
 
 
• He is the author of various poetry including "Natak Jari Hai. He is the recipient of the Sahitya Academy Award, for his 1997 anthology, Anubhav Ke Aakash Mein Chand.
 
 
 
• **Mamta Kalia - **is an Indian author and poet writing primarily in the Hindi language. She won the Vyas Samman in 2017 for her novel Dukhham Sukhham.
